description:
Create a map of Africa in gvSIG Desktop and export it as an image.

1. Create a new View and load these three shapefiles from /home/ga/gvsig_data/:
   - countries/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp
   - rivers/ne_110m_rivers_lake_centerlines.shp
   - cities/ne_110m_populated_places.shp

2. Arrange the layers in the Table of Contents so they draw correctly:
   - Cities (points) on TOP
   - Rivers (lines) in the MIDDLE
   - Countries (polygons) on the BOTTOM

3. Navigate the view (Zoom/Pan) to show the African continent.

4. Export the current map view as a PNG image to the specific path: /home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/africa_rivers_map.png.
   (Use 'View > Export > Image' or the equivalent button).
